title: Fyodorov's Russian Cosmism and resurrection

tellings.quote: It began with a librarian and philosopher named Nikolai Fyodorov, who believed the true task of humanity and Christianity was not to await resurrection, but to cause it.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, traces a line of ideas back to Russia, to a librarian and philosopher named Nikolai Fyodorov, the founder of a school of thought called Russian Cosmism. Michels says Fyodorov believed the true task of humanity and of Christianity was not to wait for the dead to be raised, but to make it happen. Michels tells it as the starting point of an episode about the space agency NASA and UFOs, as if this old dream of beating death sits underneath later space science.
